facts.fact: National Treasury's OCPO deck says the eTenders system handles tender publication, online bid submission (eSubmission), online bid evaluations and publication of awards, used by 892 organs of state.

National Treasury's OCPO deck says eTenders covers procurement planning, tender publication, online bid submission and evaluation, awards data and contract lifecycle management for 892 organs of state.
National Treasury's OCPO deck gives eTenders averages of 3,300 tenders and 1,800 awards a month, and 95% of tenders by eSubmission.
